terms-of-service.title: Shopping terms
terms-of-service.body:
Review product options, quantities, delivery address and the final amount before ordering. Order placement records your request; payment and delivery have separate confirmation states.

You can request cancellation from your account while the order is Pending or Confirmed. Contact the shop for other cases.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy information
privacy-policy.body:
Account, contact and delivery information supports purchases and customer service. Keep passwords and two-factor recovery codes private. Sign out on shared devices.

Your display name and approved comments may be public. The storefront does not publish comment emails or moderation records.

shipping-policy.title: Delivery information
shipping-policy.body:
Available delivery options and prices depend on the destination and goods. Enter a complete address and confirm a valid quote at checkout.

Track recorded updates in your account or order lookup. Contact the shop if delivery fails or goods arrive damaged.

returns-policy.title: Return requests
returns-policy.body:
For an order completed within the last 7 days, open its details in your account and submit a reason. This window starts at the original completion time.

A request starts staff review; it does not confirm receipt of goods or a refund. Keep goods until you receive instructions. Acceptance, condition, refund amount and shipping costs require review. Goods are not sellable until physically received and inspected.

warranty-policy.title: Warranty information
warranty-policy.body:
Coverage depends on the product and its assigned warranty record. Check activation and coverage dates in your account or the warranty page. Ask the shop to confirm product-specific conditions.

Keep the order code and product identifier ready for support. Do not post full serial numbers or personal purchase details in public comments.

about-us.title: About WorkspaceEcom
about-us.body: Products for your workspace. Review the variant, dimensions, price, stock and installation requirements on the product page. Ask the shop about unpublished details before purchasing.
